description:
A personal anime library manager for watching and tracking your collection in real time. Lightweight, powerful, and paws-itively fast. No waiting required!

A pure JS BitTorrent streaming environment, with a built-in list manager.
Imagine qBit + Taiga + MPV, all in a single package, but streamed real-time.
Completely ad free with no tracking/data collection.
Unlike qBit's sequential approach, seeking into data that hasn't been downloaded yet will prioritise downloading that data, instead of simply closing MPV.
- feat(dialog): add picker for importing multiple torrent files
- feat(client): add setting to queue imported torrents
  - Allows imported magnet links and .torrent files to be queued in the background without replacing the active torrent or interrupting playback.
- fix(client): unable to add .torrent files
- fix(ui): highlighted dropdown selections
- fix(ui): use proper fallback images
- fix(details): favourite button reactivity
- fix(player): preserve android navigation bar hiding in fullscreen
- fix(workflow): skip quality checks when publishing
- chore(ui): show loading spinner while queueing
- chore(mappings): update endpoint
- chore(deps): update
